$comment: The one route table for the same-origin frontend edge. Both edges read it: the Helm chart via .Files.Get (which is why the file lives inside the chart) and Compose via docker/nginx-fullstack.conf, which scripts/generate-nginx-config.mjs renders from here. Adding an API namespace is one row; never hand-edit the generated conf or restate a location in the chart. spaRoutes are exact-match locations that serve index.html — they must be listed here rather than left to the SPA fallback whenever an `^~` API prefix would otherwise swallow them, because a `^~` prefix skips regex locations. apiLocations are proxied prefixes in nginx-declaration order; spaFallback marks the ones a browser navigation should hand back to the SPA.

spaRoutes.note: Keep the frontend auth entry point on the public origin. Without this exact match, nginx canonicalizes the adjacent `/auth/` proxy location and emits an absolute redirect to its internal listener.

apiLocations.note: Better Auth owns /api/auth, including the Telegram OIDC callback. This route must never fall through to the SPA navigation fallback.
